raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

On ROCm, `GroupCoordinator.fused_allreduce_rmsnorm` uses AITER's 1-stage fused AR+RMSNorm kernel only when the payload is ≤ 128 KiB. The kernel's actual limits are its one-block-per-token budget (`kMaxBlocks = 80`) and its read volume, `world_size × payload`, since every rank reads every peer. A payload cutoff tracks neither: at bf16 and hidden 6144 it is exhausted at 10 tokens, so ordinary TP=2/4 decode batches go to the slower 2-stage kernel.

## Modifications

- Select 1-stage when `token_num <= 80` and `payload * world_size <= 8 * 128 KiB`. TP=8 keeps the current cutoff; at hidden 6144, batches of 11–42 tokens (TP=2) and 11–21 tokens (TP=4) move to 1-stage.
- `SGLANG_USE_1STAGE_ALLREDUCE` still overrides the choice. `fused_allreduce_rmsnorm_quant_per_group` is unchanged; it has its own TP=8 rule (#24651).
- `test_aiter_allreduce_fusion_amd.py` labels shapes using the two new constants.

## Accuracy Tests

GSM8K, 5-shot, greedy, 1319 items, `lm_eval --model local-completions` with `num_concurrent=16` so decode batches fall in the new window; strict-match.

| model | TP | main | PR |
|---|---:|---|---|
| GLM-5.3 (FP8) | 4 | 0.9271 (0.9189–0.9310, 5 runs) | 0.9253 (0.9212–0.9287, 5 runs) |
| Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B MXFP4 (control, same kernel choice at TP=8) | 8 | 0.8355 / 0.8415 | 0.8393 |

- On GLM-5.3, per-sample verdict agreement is 95.1–96.7 % main vs. PR and 95.5–96.5 % main vs. main.
- On identical inputs (TP=4, hidden 6144, m = 8–20), the two kernels produce bit-identical residual output; the normed output differs in ~6 per million elements by 1 bf16 ulp.
- `test_aiter_allreduce_fusion_amd.py`: 12 passed.

Per-run results: [GSM8K](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42198#issuecomment-5969027613).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

8× MI355X, main `0072e2cc08`, amd-aiter `0.1.23.dev183`, torch `2.11.0+rocm10.0.0`. Each arm runs in blocks of 4 with the first run discarded, two blocks in opposite arm order; e2e starts a fresh server per run.

**Micro**, `benchmark/kernels/all_reduce/benchmark_fused_ar_rms_amd.py`, fused graph-mode p50, block-minimum gain per shape ([per run](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42198#issuecomment-5969027373)):

| TP | shapes that switch | median gain | range | other shapes |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 2 | 13 | **+17.2 %** | +13.7 … +23.2 % | −0.1 % ¹ |
| 4 | 14 | **+5.7 %** | +0.8 … +14.6 % | −0.5 … +0.1 % |
| 8 | 0 | — | — | −1.6 … +0.6 % |

¹ 131 × 6144. 3 × 6144 (8 µs) reads −2.3 % / +0.5 % in the two blocks.

**e2e, GLM-5.3 TP=4**, median of 6 warm runs per arm ([per run](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42198#issuecomment-5969027474)):

| metric | c15 main | c15 PR | Δ | c11 main | c11 PR | Δ |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Total tok/s | 1848.8 | 1866.3 | +0.95 % | 1495.8 | 1521.4 | +1.71 % |
| Mean TTFT (ms) | 639.2 | 636.9 | −0.37 % | 489.6 | 491.8 | +0.45 % |
| Median TTFT (ms) | 753.5 | 753.9 | +0.06 % | 462.1 | 452.6 | −2.05 % |
| Mean TPOT (ms) | 23.30 | 23.08 | −0.91 % | 21.29 | 20.93 | −1.69 % |
| Median TPOT (ms) | 23.11 | 22.87 | −1.04 % | 21.14 | 20.81 | −1.56 % |

TTFT deltas are within run-to-run spread. GLM-5.3 enables the fusion for decode only, and CUDA graph bs 12 and 16 are the only captured sizes that switch kernel. A decode step makes 156 fused calls (2 × 78 layers); the micro saving of 0.7–1.5 µs per call gives 0.1–0.23 ms per step, consistent with the TPOT change.

**e2e controls**, Δ PR vs. main, all within run-to-run spread:

| model | path | workload | Total tok/s | Mean TPOT | Median TPOT | Mean TTFT |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP8, TP=4 | not called | c15 | +0.04 % | −0.11 % | −0.14 % | −0.70 % |
| | | c11 | +0.03 % | −0.04 % | −0.03 % | +0.95 % |
| Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B MXFP4, TP=8 | called, same kernel | c15 | −0.09 % | −0.07 % | −0.08 % | +1.51 % |
| | | c11 | +0.06 % | +0.06 % | +0.07 % | −0.34 % |

<details><summary>Commands</summary>

```bash
# GLM-5.3 (FP8), TP=4
python3 -m sglang.launch_server --model-path zai-org/GLM-5.3 --tp-size 4 \
    --dsa-prefill-backend tilelang --dsa-decode-backend tilelang --chunked-prefill-size 32768 \
    --mem-fraction-static 0.85 --trust-remote-code --disable-radix-cache
# Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP8, TP=4
python3 -m sglang.launch_server --model-path Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP8 --tp-size 4 \
    --attention-backend aiter --page-size 32 --chunked-prefill-size 16384 --mem-fraction-static 0.9 \
    --enable-aiter-allreduce-fusion --trust-remote-code --disable-radix-cache
# Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B MXFP4, TP=8
python3 -m sglang.launch_server --model-path <Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B MXFP4> --tp-size 8 \
    --mem-fraction-static 0.9 --enable-aiter-allreduce-fusion --trust-remote-code --disable-radix-cache

# c15 / c11
python3 -m sglang.benchmark.serving --backend sglang --dataset-name random --random-input-len 1031 \
    --random-output-len 509 --random-range-ratio 1.0 --seed 1234 --num-prompts 60 --max-concurrency 15
python3 -m sglang.benchmark.serving --backend sglang --dataset-name random --random-input-len 1031 \
    --random-output-len 509 --random-range-ratio 1.0 --seed 1234 --num-prompts 44 --max-concurrency 11
```

</details>

Other models that reach this path at TP=2/4 with `--enable-aiter-allreduce-fusion`: MiniMax-M3, MiniMax-M2.7, Qwen3.5-397B-A17B, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, Qwen3-Next-80B, gpt-oss-120b, Kimi-Linear. No effect on CUDA or at TP=8.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

 # creation so runtime collectives do not silently fall back to backend defaults.
 _MODEL_PARALLEL_GROUP_TIMEOUT: Optional[timedelta] = None
 
+# AITER fused AR+RMSNorm 1-stage kernel: one block per token up to kMaxBlocks,
+# and every rank reads every peer, so its read volume is payload * world_size
+# (128 KiB of payload at world_size 8).
+_FUSED_AR_RMS_1STAGE_MAX_TOKENS = 80
+_FUSED_AR_RMS_1STAGE_MAX_READ_BYTES = 8 * 128 * 1024
+
 
 def get_torch_distributed_pg_options(group_name=None):
     if not _is_npu:

             return None
 
-        # 1-stage vs 2-stage selection for fused AR+RMSNorm:
-        # The 1-stage kernel launches one block per token and is capped at
-        # 80 tokens (kMaxBlocks).  Guard with a byte threshold so large
-        # prefill batches fall through to the 2-stage kernel instead of
-        # hitting a runtime error.  AITER's C++ dispatch already gates
-        # which hidden_dims have valid 1-stage support.
+        # 1-stage vs 2-stage selection for fused AR+RMSNorm; large batches
+        # fall through to the 2-stage kernel. AITER's C++ dispatch already
+        # gates which hidden_dims have valid 1-stage support.
         if envs.SGLANG_USE_1STAGE_ALLREDUCE.is_set():

## GSM8K results, per run

MI355X (gfx950) ×8. Both arms run upstream main `0072e2cc08` Python on the image's compiled sglang build (`0.5.21.dev20261002+gedee4308bc`), torch `2.11.0+rocm10.0.0`, amd-aiter `0.1.23.dev183`; the PR arm adds this diff only (`322178d2dc`).

Every run starts a fresh server; all 1319 items, 5-shot, greedy:

```bash
python3 -m sglang.launch_server --model-path <model> --tp-size <tp> <model flags> --disable-radix-cache --context-length 4096 --random-seed 1234
lm_eval --model local-completions --model_args model=<model>,base_url=http://127.0.0.1:<port>/v1/completions,num_concurrent=16,max_retries=3,tokenized_requests=False,tokenizer_backend=None \
    --tasks gsm8k --num_fewshot 5 --batch_size 1 --gen_kwargs temperature=0,max_gen_toks=256 --seed 1234 --log_samples
```

`num_concurrent=16` keeps decode batches inside the window (GLM-5.3 at TP=4 runs graph bs 12 and 16 on the 1-stage kernel with this PR).
